Bihar Bypoll Sees Low Turnout Amidst Political Speculation

By-elections were held on Thursday in Bihar's Bankipur constituency, along with seats in Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat. Voter turnout in Bankipur was reported at 34%, significantly lower than in previous elections. This reduced turnout has heightened political tension, with various parties analyzing its implications for their prospects. Prashant Kishor, a key figure in Bankipur, raised questions about police conduct during the polling. Accusations of a "silent understanding" and secret support between RJD-Congress and Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraj party have also surfaced.
